title: Bullockbefriending bard
html_source:
Stephen gave himself the nickname at the end of the first chapter.
“Mulligan will dub me a new name: the bullockbefriending bard.”

anchor.prefix: phantoms, Stephen said. Why think of them? If I call them into life across the waters of Lethe will not the poor ghosts troop to my call? Who supposes it? I, Bous Stephanoumenos,
anchor.suffix: , am lord and giver of their life. He encircled his gadding hair with a coronal of vineleaves, smiling at Vincent. That answer and those leaves, Vincent said to him, will adorn you
